description: PEL demerger of 2022-08-30 (4 Piramal Pharma shares per PEL share, record date 2022-09-01). Recorded PROVISIONAL, NOT verified. NSE circular NSE/CMTR/53437 (25 Aug 2022) ran a Pre-Open 2 call auction for PEL on 2022-08-30 and states 'Post price discovery, base price shall be the discovered price'; the base price is NSE's own ex-date open in the stored bhavcopy. The Rs 1,050 quoted by the press is BSE's price, not NSE's. Not a tax cost allocation (6.58%).
formula: factor = base_price / prev_close, base_price = ex-date OPEN (special pre-open session settlement) in the NSE bhavcopy, prev_close = previous session's close

resolutions.entitlement_reported: 4 Piramal Pharma shares (Rs 10) per 1 PEL share (Rs 2); record date 2022-09-01 (PEL's own Reg 42 filing of 2022-08-18)
resolutions.limitation: primary rule (NSE/CMTR/53437) and the exchange's own bhavcopy open; no independent source confirms the number 1055.05 (BSE's price, Rs 1,050, is a different exchange's auction). PROVISIONAL until the owner decides its provenance.
